```python
v = parse_version_info("3.4.5-rc.1")
expected = parse_version_info("3.4.6-rc.1")
assert v.bump_patch().bump_prerelease() == expected
```

So `bump_patch()` on `3.4.5-rc.1` should give `3.4.6-rc.1`, and then `bump_prerelease()` should keep it as `3.4.6-rc.1` (not increment to `rc.2`).

This means `bump_prerelease` should NOT increment if the prerelease already exists with the same token! It should only bump when there's no prerelease or when the prerelease doesn't match the token.
